I'll be in Paris on the 15th of November and I'm craving some Israeli cuisine. Can you help me find a restaurant with great ratings and reviews?
            Also, could you please add an event to my calendar for the 14th of November to remind me to book a table? The event title should be 'Dinner at {restaurant_name}', and the location set to the restaurant's address.

China Garden

```python
from datetime import datetime

# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all the restaurants
restaurant_names = [restaurant["name"] for restaurant in all_restaurants]

# Get the cuisine type of the restaurants
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)

# Filter the restaurants that serve Israeli cuisine
israeli_restaurants = [restaurant for restaurant, cuisine in cuisine_types.items() if cuisine == "Israeli"]

# Get the ratings and reviews of the Israeli restaurants
ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(israeli_restaurants)

# Find the restaurant with the highest rating
best_restaurant = max(ratings_and_reviews, key=ratings_and_reviews.get)

# Get the address of the best restaurant
restaurant_address = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant])[best_restaurant]

# Create a calendar event for the 14th of November
event_title = f"Dinner at {best_restaurant}"
event_start_time = datetime(2024, 11, 14, 18, 0, 0).isoformat()
event_end_time = datetime(2024, 11, 14, 20, 0, 0).isoformat()
create_calendar_event(event_title, event_start_time, event_end_time, "", None, restaurant_address)
```
